Limit cables: 2-core twisted 22 AWG, cut lengths in ELE-002. Firmware: INPUT_PULLUP, LOW = not triggered.

1. Every wire: ferrule at screw terminals, label sleeve with its Wxxx number at both ends.
1. Every wire: ferrule at screw terminals, label sleeve with its Wxxx number at both ends.
2. Driver DIP: NEMA23 2.84 A peak, NEMA17 1.46 A; 800 pulses/rev on all (MICROSTEP = 4).
2. Driver DIP: NEMA23 2.84 A peak, NEMA17 1.46 A; 800 pulses/rev on all (MICROSTEP = 4).
3. Common anode: +5 V to PUL+/DIR+/ENA+; Mega pins sink PUL-/DIR-/ENA-.

4. ENABLE: D12 HIGH = drivers off (firmware). E-stop S1 cuts +24 V to every driver.

5. One 0 V star point at TB2. Mega GND only to limit switches (TB4), not to TB2.

6. Motor and limit cables leave through the ENC-06 glands (PG9 motor, PG7 limit).

7. Never plug or unplug a motor with the drivers powered.

8. Mains wiring (X0 to PSU1) by a qualified person; earth all aluminium panels to E1.
